answer: Require each agent to lock a deposit before it can trade, and burn the deposit if it cheats. One fake identity is cheap, but an attacker who wants to forge a hundred of them pays a hundred deposits, so the attack costs more than it earns. The registry gives each bonded agent a sable stamp, a dark mark that is easy to check and hard to copy, and the plume of cheap copies collapses once every copy has to pay its own way in.
